feat(calls): conditioned call surface domain computation Shared evidence assessment for Projected Call Surface. Two functions: loadConditionedCallEvidence() — retrieves expirations and chain data from cache with freshness metadata. Uses explicit DTE range policy. assessConditionedCallSurface() — pure domain function evaluating call landscape from a conditioned ownership basis. No cache access. Accepts normalized ConditionedOwnershipInput independent of PutCandidate or OpenShortPut. Output is structured evidence: per-expiration assessment, aggregate counts, representative qualifying opportunities (bounded to 5, sorted by delta proximity to target), all applicable pass/fail reasons per contract, basis-relative geometry (strike distance, above/below), explicit evidence availability, partiality, and freshness. No quality score or classification. Measurement and policy remain distinct. Reuses existing call admissibility and execution policy. Calls below basis remain measurable evidence. One computation, two entry points: proposed-put (projected-mid basis) and existing-put (strike-only conservative basis). Tests: 13 domain-level (evidence states, basis geometry, policy filtering, yield from basis, multi-expiration aggregation, multiple failure reasons, below-basis measurability, freshness preservation).

SQLite persistence: durable evidence store with behavioral equivalence The Evidence Appliance now persists acquisition state to SQLite. Service restarts recover evidence in milliseconds instead of re-acquiring the entire universe (~22min at 496 symbols, ~57min at 1,286). Implementation: - better-sqlite3 with WAL mode and foreign keys enabled - Migration runner (numbered .sql files, tracked in _migrations table) - Schema: symbols, universe_sources, symbol_membership, evidence, symbol_resolution, snapshot_state (6 tables) - SqliteEvidenceStore implements same interface as InMemoryEvidenceStore - Generation advances on publishSnapshot(), not individual writes - Failed refresh preserves last successful payload - Absence is a resolution outcome, not a separate evidence type - EVIDENCE_DB_PATH configurable (default: ./data/evidence.sqlite3) Migration pattern: - InMemoryEvidenceStore retained as test oracle - 11 behavioral equivalence tests prove identical behavior: same operations → same snapshot, restart recovery, work queue correctness, failed-refresh preservation, generation semantics - SQLite authoritative from day one (tests prove equivalence pre-deploy) Wiring: - getEvidenceStore() singleton returns SqliteEvidenceStore - Worker calls store.publishSnapshot() after each batch - Snapshot and status routes unchanged (same method signatures) 929 tests pass (35 backend + 894 frontend).
